purpose: Sourcing only: local candidates for garment import/binding and product-image colour/texture tests. No shipped assets changed.
path_base: repository root; every cached path is POSIX-style and gitignored

field_semantics.status: accepted means licence and download verified, not ready to ship or tested for fitting; rejected entries must not be imported
field_semantics.triangle_count: Whole downloaded mesh/character, after OBJ fan triangulation; garment_triangle_count is the isolated clothing selection where provided
field_semantics.bounding_box_height_m: Whole downloaded geometry, not human stature; legacy OBJ meters inferred with explicit scale_basis
field_semantics.pose: A/T refer to undeformed body-relative garment rest pose; none is a prop/standalone shoe
field_semantics.type: sweater is kept distinct from hoodie/sweatshirt; no substitution hidden in counts
field_semantics.files: Actual downloaded files with public URL, repository-relative cache path, byte size and SHA-256
field_semantics.unknown: null indicates not known/not applicable; never silently substituted with a made-up value

gaps: Only one accepted actual hoodie; two knit sweaters are explicit alternatives. No accepted actual sweatshirt model.
Only one licence-consistent jeans candidate retained; a second downloaded candidate was rejected after its OBJ contradicted the CC-BY page and binding.
No dedicated finished chino found; suit trousers and a tight base-mesh alternative are retained.
No matched same-product front/back photo pair found; each image records its own view.
Many meshes are low-poly legacy MHCLO proxies. Realism/PBR upgrades remain preparation work, not a sourcing success claim.

integration_notes: Do not change or commit cached source files. Catalogue and summary are metadata only.
Before shipping any CC-BY candidate, add its exact author/source/licence attribution and all conversion modifications to CREDITS.md. That edit is outside this task's scope.
Do not infer 4.0 from an unspecified CC-BY label. Such candidates are explicitly rejected here.
Photos with people are flagged; keep them local in the ignored cache and exercise the existing browser-only photo flow.
Do not import research-only, NC, ND, editorial, share-alike or restricted royalty-free material from the rejected/source-audit lists.
For MHCLO sources, confirm legacy decimeter versus newer meter geometry and helper-vertex/shear support before binding.

source_audit.result: Browsed all 23 chronological clothes pages and checked shortlisted per-asset pages and MHCLO headers. Both modern and older items were assessed; existing seven shipped templates were not counted as new.
Public character page returned HTTP 402/403. No anonymous downloadable garment verified; skipped rather than using a subscription/login.
Checked apparel model catalogue; catalogue/API requests returned HTTP 403 or an unloaded list. No priority garment with verified item-level licence and download retained.
CC Attribution listing, approximately 375.6K triangles. Download API requires authenticated access; skipped without signing in or scraping viewer data.
Author says CC0 but listing says CC-BY; approximately 764K triangles and download access requires login. No files retained.
Basic Hoodie is listed CC0; download requires account access. Skipped.
Checked asset catalogue. No independently useful priority garment with an anonymous download verified in this pass.

Per-pack page says CC0. Official public Google Drive GLTF links returned quota-exceeded pages; obtained the same author's modular hoodie and casual character from independently CC0-marked Poly Pizza pages instead.
Item-level CC0 verified and ZIP downloaded/inspected; rejected as a thin hanging prop.
Search page was inaccessible in this session. No wearable garment with verified item-level CC0 and public direct download retained.
Model-specific CC-BY-4.0 licence verified; downloaded and inspected. SheenCloth is a draped fabric sample, not a garment, so not downloaded.

Verified individual file licensing sections and batched imageinfo.extmetadata, downloaded 13 images and visually reviewed them. Used 960px or 250px documented thumbnails where originals were rate-limited.
CC0/PD-filtered API query returned HTTP 403 without credentials. Skipped.

Current custom licence is not CC0/PD and restricts resale/competing-service compilation; excluded current-site downloads. Historical CC0-marked Commons image is separately evidenced on its own file page.
Current custom licence restricts unaltered resale/stock redistribution; not CC0/PD, so excluded.
